purpose.dashboard: Overview of words, senses, recent imports, running jobs and today's AI cost.
purpose.words: Word list with spelling variants, editorial level and function-word flag.
purpose.senses: Draft senses, mark them reviewed, publish and see the revision history.
purpose.topics: Add, rename in Vietnamese and English, and archive topics.
purpose.unknownForms: Inflected forms the tables do not know (go → went, gone) to accept or skip; they are used to check AI-generated questions.
purpose.reports: Queue of questions reported by learners; hide, remove or restore a question.
purpose.reportReasons: Add, edit and turn off the reasons learners can pick when reporting a question.
purpose.refunds: Give AI uses back to a learner when an AI error has been confirmed.
purpose.users: User list, account status, lock or unlock.
purpose.entitlements: Grant and revoke access and AI uses for learners, with a reason and an expiry.
purpose.aiModels: Add OpenAI and Anthropic models and turn each one on or off.
purpose.aiOperations: Choose the model, effort, thinking and maximum tokens for each AI operation.
purpose.aiPrompts: Write the prompt for each operation, see its revision history and run a test.
purpose.aiEval: Approved example sets and their run results before AI is enabled for learners.
purpose.aiCosts: Log of every AI call, totals per day and per model, invoice reconciliation.
purpose.aiCalls: Every AI call: operation, model, time, result and cost.
purpose.settings: The numbers that steer the system: reminders, learning and review, practice, plans and uses, content, AI.
